objectives.topic_name: The Renaissance & The Reformation (Roots of Individual Conscience)
objectives.objective_text: Describe how Johannes Gutenberg's movable-type printing press worked and why it was a breakthrough.

objectives.topic_name: The Renaissance & The Reformation (Roots of Individual Conscience)
objectives.objective_text: Analyze how the printing press connected to broader developments like the Renaissance and the Reformation.

standards: C3 D2.His.1.6-8 — Analyze connections among events and developments in broader historical contexts (history, grades 6-8)

objectives.topic_name: The Renaissance & The Reformation (Roots of Individual Conscience)
objectives.objective_text: Explain the multiple effects of the printing press on literacy, the spread of ideas, and the cost of books.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.6-8 — Explain multiple causes and effects of events and developments in the past (history, grades 6-8)

objectives.topic_name: The Renaissance & The Reformation (Roots of Individual Conscience)
objectives.objective_text: Analyze how the printing press accelerated the spread of Reformation and Enlightenment ideas across Europe.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.9-12 — Analyze multiple and complex causes and effects of events in the past (history, grades 9-12)

objectives.topic_name: The Renaissance & The Reformation (Roots of Individual Conscience)
objectives.objective_text: Evaluate how Gutenberg's invention, arising in 15th-century Germany, reshaped the broader course of European intellectual and religious history.

standards: C3 D2.His.1.9-12 — Evaluate how historical events and developments were shaped by unique circumstances of time and plac (history, grades 9-12)
